scheme_name: National AIDS Control Organisation (NACO) Internship Programme
other_conditions: Applicant must be a student pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate, M.Phil or PhD courses in relevant disciplines such as Preventive & Social Medicine, Public Health, Health Management, Statistics, Social Sciences etc., from a recognized and reputed university
Preference will be given to candidates with an excellent academic track record or relevant research/project work
benefits_summary: Stipend of ₹8,000 per month, certificate on successful completion, and provision of office logistics support.
